Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 13, 2025#Syria: explosion heard over #Quneitra province after Israeli air defenses were activated to counter what seems to be an Iranian suicide drone which wasn't shot down previously.12311277K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 13, 2025#Syria: the Iranian suicide drone (Shahed-136, known for its distinctive noisy flight) was filmed seconds before being intercepted by Israel over #Quneitra province.00:002103611K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 13, 2025S. #Syria: interception of an Iranian suicide drone launched at Israel was caught live over #Quneitra province.00:002225912K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 14, 2025#Syria: in addition to the Shahed-136 UAVs, Iran (or more likely allied militias) also launched Shahed-101 suicide models, as shown by the remains recovered today in Southern #Quneitra province.1104124K

This one crashed in #Quneitra province.1227427K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 15, 2025Iran keeps sending drones, but not in waves.
This morning alone at least 6 were shot down over S. #Syria, from Quneitra to Suwayda provinces.
Shahed-136 visible 👇00:007186111K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 15, 2025S. #Syria: kids playing with the remains of an Iranian suicide drone shot down over the Lajat (NE. #Daraa).110285.3K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 15, 2025Many Iranian suicide drones are intercepted today over S. #Syria, from #Quneitra to #Suwayda provinces.
Video 1: wreckage fell on a house in Suwayda countryside.
Video 2: UAV blown up over Yarmuk Basin, W. Daraa.00:0000:00215326K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 15, 2025S. #Syria: non-stop interception of Iranian suicide drones - launched one by one - today.
This video shot in W. #Suwayda province shows an Israeli fighter jet hunting & then blowing up one of those UAVs.00:0033213331K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 16, 2025S. #Syria: a number of Iranian suicide drones were observed arriving in the Lajat (NE. #Daraa), heading towards Israel.1483.4K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 16, 2025#Pt. The drones were intercepted in the S. #Quneitra province, sparking a fire in a field.

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 16, 2025S. #Syria: one of the Iranian drones which was blown up this morning by an Israeli jet.
Remains damaged a house near Nawa, NW. #Daraa.
Fragment of the tail shows this was a Shahed-136 UAV.
Last photo likely shows part of the interceptor used.13225.6K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 16, 2025S. #Syria: nighttime interception of an Iranian suicide drone by a fighter jet on the border with Jordan.
Another was shot down near Tell Shuayb (W. #Daraa).
Several other UAVs are still heard over the province.00:00152712K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 16, 2025S. #Syria: interception tonight of an Iranian drone over Yarmuk Basin (W. #Daraa) while another UAV, shot down over #Quneitra province, caused a fire.
Explosions continue to be heard from time to time in the Southern region.00:00153413K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 17, 2025Interception of Iranian drones continues over S. #Syria.
At least 4 were shot down by Israel this morning.
Remains of an interceptor missile (AIM-9 Sidewinder) also shown (Tafas, NW. Daraa).00:0037306.7K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 17, 2025S. #Syria: so far, today, Israel shot down at least 10 Iranian suicide drones over the province of #Daraa.00:00111285.6K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 18, 2025S. #Syria: also today, several Iranian drones (at least 8) were shot down by Israel over the provinces of #Daraa (videos), #Quneitra (first photo) & #Suwayda.00:0000:0015197.2K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 18, 2025S. #Syria: night interception of an Iranian suicide drone over the Western #Daraa countryside.00:0012236K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 19, 2025S. #Syria: fragments of Iranian drones intercepted over the last ~12 hours over #Daraa, #Quneitra & #Suwayda provinces.
Second one has a dedication, partially readable: "[...] ya Zionists".463518K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 19, 2025S. #Syria: two Iranian Shahed-101 drones shot down today, in #Daraa & #Suwayda provinces.
First video provides close-up of the components & what appear to be shrapnels.
2nd is dedicated to Fatima Masuma & an IRGC commander slain in 1983.
Both drones have closely matching numbers.00:0000:0023319.8K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 20, 2025S. #Syria: impressive video showing an Iranian suicide drone (Shahed-136) blown up this morning by an Israeli F-16 over #Daraa province (Jordanian border).00:0043310882K

Qalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqS. #Syria: a woman was severely wounded this morning during an interception by an Israeli warplane of an Iranian drone over the Eastern #Daraa countryside.
So far today, at least 8 Iranian UAVs were shot down in the South.00:0012:07 PM · Jun 20, 202517KViews110381

UAV fell with its warhead intact.00:00153715KQalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 23, 2025S. #Syria: over the past 2 days, the number of drones intercepted over #Daraa & #Quneitra provinces significantly decreased, as Iran has diversified the routes used to target Israel.
First photo shows a Shahed-136 UAV observed today while flying over Zabadani, on Lebanese border.12276.8KQalaat Al Mudiq@QalaatAlMudiqJun 24, 2025#Syria: this Iranian Shahed-136 was intercepted by an Israeli jet circa 45 minutes ago over the area of Kanaker, S. #Damascus.00:00111456.1K
